_comment: Example MCP client config for the compose test stack. Pick ONE of the two blocks: 'direct' (two servers) or 'gateway' (one multiplexed endpoint). The 'mcpServers' object is the Claude Code / Claude Desktop .mcp.json format; Hermes takes the same name + url pairs (see README). Tool names are identical in both modes (wiki_* and inbox_*). In production replace the URLs with the agentgateway hostname; auth (Authentik) is handled there.
